title: ReSFlow: Rectifying Categorical Flows on Statistical Manifolds for One-Step Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.13225v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative modeling for discrete data has been significantly advanced by learning continuous vector fields on the statistical manifolds to transport simple priors to target discrete distributions. However, because these continuous-time flows are not constrained to follow geodesics on the statistical manifold, thereby requiring multi-step numerical integration for simulation and leading to substantial computational costs during inference. In this work, drawing inspiration from the "straight and fast" properties of Rectified Flow in continuous Euclidean space, we propose the Rectified Statistical Flow (ReSFlow) model, which enables one-step categorical generation on statistical manifolds by explicitly learning geodesic trajectories that adhere to the intrinsic Riemannian geometry. By rectifying the flow on the statistical manifold, we theoretically guarantee that trajectories between prior and target distributions approximate geodesics.

translated_title: ReSFlow：在统计流形上校正类别流以实现一步生成
translated_abstract: 在统计流形上学习连续向量场，将简单先验分布传输至目标离散分布，极大地推动了离散数据的生成建模。然而，由于这些连续时间流不受沿统计流形测地线运动的约束，因此需要进行多步数值积分来模拟，导致推理阶段产生高昂的计算成本。在本工作中，受连续欧几里得空间中校正流“直而快”特性的启发，我们提出了校正统计流模型，该模型通过显式学习遵循内蕴黎曼几何的测地线轨迹，实现了统计流形上的一步类别生成。通过在统计流形上校正流，我们从理论上保证了先验分布与目标分布之间的轨迹逼近测地线。
tldr: 提出ReSFlow模型，通过在统计流形上校正类别流使其轨迹逼近测地线，实现离散数据的一步生成，大幅降低推理计算成本。
en_tdlr: ReSFlow rectifies categorical flows on statistical manifolds so that trajectories approximate geodesics, enabling one-step generation of discrete data with greatly reduced inference cost.
